label: Manga / webtoon 漫剧
source: skill:manga-character-sheet; skill:character-sheet-design §7 style router (anime / manga / webtoon / guoman)

anchors.global: AI-generated vertical manga-style micro-drama frame, consistent line language and cel shading, on-model faces and silhouettes
anchors.characterBase: manga character identity reference, consistent line weight and cel shading, on-model face and silhouette, image-to-video ready
anchors.characterSheet: manga character performance board derived from a confirmed base reference, expressions and head angles and poses and hands in a consistent line language
anchors.keyframe: AI-generated manga-style keyframe for vertical micro-drama, consistent line language and cel shading
anchors.location: manga background plate of the location with no characters present, consistent perspective and line language
anchors.cover: manga / manju short drama cover, illustrated key art, genre and conflict legible instantly

negatives.shared: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, UI overlays, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed anatomy, blurry, low quality
negatives.photoreal: photoreal actors, live-action photography, cosplay, 3d render, plastic skin
negatives.characterBase: scene, environment, poster composition, collage, readable text, labels, placeholder boxes
negatives.keyframe: inconsistent line weight, off-model face, clothing change, prop change, random background change
negatives.cover: duplicated title, invented subtitle, genre tag, fake platform UI, wrong-language text

characterBase.spec: one manga character identity reference on pure white, full body from hair top to footwear bottom, consistent line weight and cel shading, on-model face and silhouette, single consistent camera and ground line

characterSheet.spec: one manga character performance board on pure white, a compact turnaround in the upper quarter and below it distinct panels for expressions and head angles and poses and hand gestures, same face throughout with a different expression and angle in every panel

location.spec: manga background plate of the location with no characters, consistent perspective

cover.spec: illustrated manga key art cover, one dominant grammar, relationship or reversal legible immediately

continuityClause: Keep the same character identity across shots: same face, hairstyle, costume, line weight, and shading system. Keep location perspective consistent.
